Method of Attack: Bring Your Own Vulnerable Driver (BYOVD) to disable antivirus software
Phishing emails to steal employee credentials for initial access
Abuse of Windows PsExec tool to execute malicious batch files
Use of vulnerable Martini.sys driver to terminate antivirus and security processes
Execution of ransomware binary (smartscreen_protected.exe) to encrypt files using ChaCha20 and RSA encryption
Clearing system event logs to erase traces
Impacted Systems: Windows systems protected by antivirus products targeted by Martini driver
Attack Vector: Lateral movement using stolen credentials and PsExec tool
Indicators of Compromise: Ransom note dropped in encrypted directories
Changed desktop wallpaper with ransom note
Use of wevutil.exe commands to clear event logs
